scope: Read-only exact source + actual native error attribution, not a GLSL-driver compile/pass test. No renderer, material, feature, clock, camera or source changes applied.
controls: actual global patch introduces derivative reference into smooth normal path
native smooth MeshNormalMaterial has no enabling flat/bump/tangent-normal macro
native normal vertex/fragment declare view varying only behind exact feature guard
native normal fragment consumes patched shared normal chunk
native GTAO creates unchanged smooth normal material and renders it as scene override
FLAT_SHADED negative control has native view-position declaration
USE_BUMPMAP negative control has native view-position declaration
USE_NORMALMAP_TANGENTSPACE negative control has native view-position declaration
unapplied narrow proposal supplies the actual native view position in BOTH stages
actual captured errors identify MeshNormalMaterial and undeclared view varying
cause: Global smooth normal fallback references vViewPosition, but native smooth MeshNormalMaterial removes BOTH declaration and assignment behind false flat/bump/tangent-map guards. GLSL checks both ternary arms even when normal is nonzero. Ultra GTAO uses this exact default scene override; High tier has ao:false. Three program errors per captured Sky source are real; program variant attribution beyond the native error logs remains unrecorded.
